Sufficient-statistics M-step, model selection, new algorithms and four new model families.

- Sufficient statistics: every M-step now runs from additive `SufficientStats`, which gives exact `batch_size` chunking and is the basis of the new online and streaming fits (`step_size`, `partial_fit`).
- New clustering metrics (WB-index, Wemmert-Gancarski, DBCV), the Integrated Completed Likelihood (`icl`) and `select_model`, which sweeps `n_components` and covariance types by BIC, AIC or ICL.
- Stochastic EM (`algorithm='sem'`), deterministic annealing (`temperature`) and Stochastic Approximation EM (`algorithm='saem'`), plus mini-batch / online EM and an Aitken stopping rule.
- All 14 Celeux & Govaert (1995) GPCM covariance models (the mclust family) as `covariance_type` codes such as `'EVE'` or `'VVE'`, with `volume_`, `shape_` and `orientation_` exposed.
- `StudentTMixture` (robust to outliers) and `VonMisesFisherMixture` (directional data) on a shared `BaseMixture` class.
- Semi-supervised fitting (`fit(X, labels=...)` with `-1` for unknown rows, several components per class) and `PositiveUnlabeledMixture` for positive-unlabeled learning.
- Tutorials extended to 17 notebooks.

Superseded by v0.4.1, which fixes bugs found after this release.
